item.title: Fix bug in window.py so python3 -m unittest passes
item.brief: Operator request (authenticated, local socket): In this repository `python3 -m unittest` fails. Find and fix the bug in `window.py` so every test passes, without changing the tests. The function must be correct for every input, not just the tested ones. Commit the fix as a local commit. Acceptance: `python3 -m unittest` exits 0; tests are unchanged; the fix generalizes to all inputs (check boundary cases such as empty input, size 1, and negative or zero values where relevant). Commit only the fix, with a plain commit message and no tool attribution lines.

reasons: sizer: elevated -> high; capped at medium; consider a stronger tier

model_reasons.implement: Small single-file bug fix with clear tests; medium effort suffices.

state.summary:
Fixed the off-by-one in window.py. sliding_windows computed range(len(items) - size), which dropped the last window. It now uses range(len(items) - size + 1). Committed locally as 38820e5 on archon/4s4r7p8v-fix-bug-in-window-py-so-python3-m-unitte; not pushed. Tests are unchanged. Before: python3 -m unittest ran 3 tests with 2 failures. After: 3 tests OK, exit 0 on the committed head. Boundary checks passed: empty input returns [], size 1 returns each item as a window, size equal to len returns one window, size greater than len returns [], and size 0 or negative raises ValueError. The reviewer (agt_01M88WAGFBAD6AMJSC8XPWFTMT) passed the head with no blocking findings. Its one non-blocking follow-up is that the tests do not cover empty input or size greater than len; I did not add tests because the task said not to change the tests. Nothing is left running. No servers or stacks were started.

REVIEW: pass, by claude-code/claude-haiku-5-5 (agent agt_01M88WAGFBAD6AMJSC8XPWFTMT)

SHIPPED: commit 38820e5f60934c1efa4bc42e5939f1e7c82694a4 on the run branch
